## Build

The top-level build script is `CMakeLists.txt` at the repository root (`cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.13)`, `project(dde-session)`).

```bash
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build -j"$(nproc)"
sudo cmake --install build
```

## Dependencies

`Build-Depends` in `debian/control` lists 15 entries; the first 8 are listed below (see `debian/control` for the complete list):

- `cmake`
- `debhelper-compat (= 11)`
- `libcap-ng-dev`
- `libdtk6core-dev`
- `libdtk6core-bin`
- `libglib2.0-dev`
- `libsecret-1-dev`
- `libsystemd-dev`

The top-level `CMakeLists.txt` looks up 2 packages with `find_package`: `DtkBuildHelper`, `Dtk`.
